scans.name: Bluebell Sustainable Business Awards
scans.eligibility: ACT business or organisation with measurable sustainability or climate outcomes.
scans.requirements: One category, project narrative, verified energy/emissions outcomes, calculations, photos and customer or partner evidence.

scans.name: Canberra Women in Business Awards
scans.eligibility: CWB membership and a woman leading or contributing in business in the Canberra region.
scans.requirements: CWB membership, category responses, attributable leadership and business results, references and profile assets.
scans.pageTitle: 2026 Canberra Women in Business Awards – Canberra Women in Business

scans.name: Australian Trades Small Business Champion Awards
scans.eligibility: Australian trade business with a current ABN and 40 or fewer FTE.
scans.requirements: ABN/FTE proof, business and category responses, team photo, quality metrics and customer evidence.

scans.name: Women in Industry Awards
scans.category: Business Development Success / Excellence in Energy
scans.eligibility: Nominee resides and works in Australia; category evidence must cover the prior two years.
scans.requirements: Initiatives, clients won, financial benefit, independent proof, bio and portrait.

scans.name: AIRAH National Awards
scans.eligibility: Relevant HVAC&R or building-services project or individual with completed, measurable outcomes.
scans.requirements: Design rationale, installation and commissioning evidence, measured performance, sustainability outcomes and photos.

scans.name: Engineers Australia Excellence Awards — Bilal
scans.eligibility: Current Engineers Australia or engineering-community membership.
scans.requirements: Four criterion responses, 2-3 page CV, short bio, portrait, pronunciation audio and referee.
scans.pageTitle: Excellence Awards 2026: People Awards entry handbook | Engineers Australia

scans.name: Smart Energy Excellence Awards
scans.category: Smart Installer / Emerging Leader / Smart Employer
scans.eligibility: Renewable-energy-sector applicant; membership and 2027 category rules must be confirmed.
scans.requirements: Install quality, innovation, safety, employer practices, customer outcomes and high-resolution images.
scans.pageTitle: Smart Energy Excellence Awards 2026 Celebrates Industry Leaders at Gala Dinner in Sydney - Smart Energy Council

scans.name: Energy Efficiency Council Awards
scans.eligibility: Project demonstrates excellence in efficiency, electrification or demand flexibility.
scans.requirements: Measured project outcomes, innovation evidence and third-party nomination for champion categories.
scans.pageTitle: EEC Award Winners 2026 - Energy Efficiency Council

scans.name: Banksia National Sustainability Awards
scans.category: SME Leadership / Business Solutions / Built Environment
scans.eligibility: National sustainability entry with measurable environmental/social outcomes aligned to the SDGs.
scans.requirements: Structured submission, SDG mapping, 500-word case study, summaries, three photos and fee.

scans.name: Telstra Best of Business Awards
scans.eligibility: Australian SME; confirm the current workforce cap and one-category rule.
scans.requirements: Growth, purpose, customer impact, business outcomes and staged verification materials.
scans.pageTitle: Telstra Best of Business Awards | Telstra

scans.name: Australian Small Business Champion Awards
scans.eligibility: Australian service business with current ABN and 40 or fewer FTE.
scans.requirements: ABN/FTE proof, category responses, team photo, business results and supporting documents.

scans.name: ACT Women's Awards
scans.eligibility: Eligible person in the ACT region whose achievements create lasting positive change.
scans.requirements: Nomination form, specific ACT impact examples, referee and supporting evidence.

scans.name: Clean Energy Council Awards
scans.eligibility: A substantial clean-energy initiative, partnership or campaign is required.
scans.requirements: Quantified community or inclusion impact, partner endorsements and a publishable case study.
scans.pageTitle: Clean Energy Council Awards | Clean Energy Council

scans.name: Australian Women's Small Business Champion Awards
scans.eligibility: At least 50% woman ownership, Australian operations, ABN and employee limits.
scans.requirements: Ownership/ABN/FTE proof, category responses, team photo and supporting evidence.

scans.name: AIRAH Towards Net Zero Competition
scans.eligibility: Under 35 and working or studying in sustainability, engineering or building services.
scans.requirements: Age/role proof, registration fee, personally completed knowledge assessment and modelling stage.
scans.pageTitle: Towards Net Zero Competition | AIRAH Awards

scans.name: ACT Multicultural Awards
scans.eligibility: ACT/Canberra nominee with a community-sector cultural inclusion initiative.
scans.requirements: Sustained community outcomes, beneficiary evidence and partner/community support.

scans.name: AusMumpreneur Awards
scans.eligibility: Australian or New Zealand mother who owns a business, nonprofit or blog.
scans.requirements: Parent/ownership confirmation, paid category, application responses, links and media assets.

scans.name: Australian Ladies in Business Initiative Awards
scans.eligibility: Australian woman in business with ABN and required online-group membership.
scans.requirements: Personal business/ABN confirmation, group membership, category fee and evidence.
scans.pageTitle: Entry Requirements – Australian Ladies in Business Initiative Awards

scans.name: Engineers Australia Excellence Awards — Ahmad
scans.eligibility: Current membership; Emerging category requires age 35 or under at the awards date.
scans.requirements: Membership/age proof, four criterion responses, CV, bio, portrait, audio and referee.
scans.pageTitle: Excellence Awards 2026: People Awards entry handbook | Engineers Australia
